concerns.text: Task T033 [P] refactors `feature_engineering.py` for streaming‑style processing, but it is scheduled *after* all data‑processing and model‑training tasks (US1‑US3). Code refactoring must occur *before* any task that consumes `feature_engineering.py`; otherwise the earlier tasks run on the pre‑refactor version, violating the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Task T032 benchmarks runtime and memory, yet it is placed *before* the refactor task T033. The benchmark will measure the un‑optimized pipeline, defeating its purpose. The benchmark should be scheduled *after* T033 (and any other performance‑affecting changes).

Task T032 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but benchmarking the full pipeline consumes exclusive CPU and RAM resources; running it in parallel with other tasks could cause resource contention and produce misleading metrics. It should not be flagged as parallel‑safe.
